line: Medusa, when she kissed me would of turned me into stone
vault_lines: Im Glad she ain't Medusa, when she kissed me would of turned me into stone
meaning: Medusa was a Gorgon, one of three sisters in Greek Mythology.  She was originally a very beautiful woman, but the goddess Athena was angered by her vanity and punished her by turning her into a hideous monster with snakes for hair and whose stare could turn someone to stone.
